subject: Security exhibit coordination — sampling bands, pen-test window & order form amendment
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@helixhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix Health Security <security@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T08:15:00Z
Subject: Request: SOC2 artifacts + pen-test window for order form

Thanks Logan / Laura —

Per our procurement checklist, we need a short plan for the security exhibit before we can finish the order form. Specifically Helix needs:

- A SOC 2 artifact mapping (what assertions + where the evidence lives)
- Proposed pen-test window (2-week window + staging access details)
- Sampling approach for log/alert samples (how many days, sample size)
- Confirmed language for the MSA regarding inspection rights and non-prod keys

I've attached an initial evidence request spreadsheet (Helix_SOC2_evidence_request_v1.xlsx) and our current order form draft — can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a 14-day pen-test window in Q3 and whether you can provide the sample sets rather than full datasets?

We'd like to get this wrapped by Jul 23 to keep the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of InfoSec, Helix Health

Attachment: Helix_SOC2_evidence_request_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 artifacts + pen-test window for order form

Tom — thanks for the clear list. High-level responses inline: 

- SOC 2 mapping: we can provide a mapping doc and the exported evidence (read-only S3 links) for the relevant controls by next week.
- Pen-test window: we can offer a 14-day window in mid-August (target Aug 9–22). We require a staging environment access plan and an approved test plan in advance.
- Sampling approach: recommended default is 7 continuous days of logs + two 8-hour alert sampling snapshots for each service in scope; we can produce sanitized samples (no PHI/PII).
- MSA language: we prefer an audit-rights paragraph that specifies timeboxed inspections, non-prod access only, and a mutually agreed statement-of-work for any deep dives. Karthik, can you propose track-changes on the MSA?

Next steps:
1) Karthik will propose specific redline language for the security exhibit and pen-test clause.
2) Laura / I will prepare the evidence mapping and a sanitized sample bundle.
3) Tom — can you confirm the Helix on-call for the test and whether Helix will accept encrypted logs only?

I'll attach our suggested redline file for the MSA (redlines_MSA_track_changes.docx) once legal has a pass.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Platform Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_MSA_track_changes.docx (Word doc, tracked changes)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 artifacts + pen-test window for order form

Adding my legal view —

Thanks all. Key points I'm putting in the MSA redline (high level):

- Inspection rights: limited to evidence and timeboxed inspection events; no blanket access to production telemetry. We will add explicit language that audits require 14 days' notice and are limited to the mutually agreed scope.
- Pen-test clause: accept Helix’s 14-day window but add a clause that Redwood may require a rollback window and must be notified of exploit types that affect customer data within 24 hours.
- Sample delivery: Redwood will deliver sanitized samples & summary metrics; we will not provide live keys or copies of production databases.
- Escalation & evidence cadence: propose weekly evidence handoff during the audit period and a post-audit findings call within 3 business days of report delivery.

I will create a track-changes MSA exhibit and an annotated pen-test addendum and share by EOD tomorrow.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T16:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 artifacts + pen-test window for order form

Operational notes from Product/Infra: 

- Staging: we will enable a staging slice with production-like telemetry but sanitized (no PHI). Access via jumpbox with time-limited keys.
- Sampling: default sample bundle = 7 days of logs (compressed) + up to 500 alert events per service. If Helix needs deeper sampling, we can scope an isolated supplemental window.
- Pen-test guardrails: testers will be allowed network-level tests, authentication/authorization checks, and synthetic load. No social engineering or live customer data exfiltration.
- Timeboxed support: Redwood on-call will provide a technical point during the 14-day window; we require test plan and list of tools 48 hours prior.

Tom — confirm whether Helix accepts the sanitized-sample approach and the 48-hour tool disclosure. If yes, we'll lock in Aug 9–22 and begin evidence prep the week of Jul 19.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Product Manager, Inference Platform

Attachment: none

From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@helixhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 artifacts + pen-test window for order form

Thanks everyone — this readout covers Helix's needs. A few quick confirmations: 

- Helix accepts staged, sanitized sample bundles and the 48-hour tool disclosure.
- We confirm Aug 9–22 for the pen-test window. Our lead tester will be on-call: Samir Patel (samir.patel@helixhealth.com).
- For the MSA, we'll accept timeboxed inspection language provided it references the pen-test addendum and includes an obligation for Redwood to notify Helix within 24 hours of any customer-impacting exploit discovery.

I've attached an updated Order Form (OrderForm_Helix_v3.pdf) with a proposed exhibit reference. Please review and let me know if legal's redline language will be ready by Jul 16 so we can circulate the amended order form to procurement.

Best,
Tom Ellis
Head of InfoSec, Helix Health
